name: retroplug2-ui
description: RetroPlug workspace root: the JS build toolchain (esbuild) and the runtime deps bundled into the UI.

scripts.test:plugin: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-plugin-test retroplug-classid-test retroplug-audio-test && node packages/retroplug/scripts/run-plugin-tests.mjs
scripts.reaper:mgb-smoke-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-rplg.js && tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke.rpp build tools/reaper-mgb-author.lua build/mgb.rplg.zip
scripts.reaper:mgb-smoke: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-rplg.js && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/mgb_smoke.rpp build/mgb.rplg.zip
scripts.reaper:analyze-smoke: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli retroplug-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/cli-analyze build/bin/retroplug-cli build/cli/analyze-mgb.js /tmp/cli-smoke.wav && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/cli-smoke.wav
scripts.cli:export-mgb-channels: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli retroplug-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/cli-chan build/bin/retroplug-cli build/cli/export-mgb-channels.js /tmp/mgb-channels
scripts.cli:render-smoke: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/cli-render build/bin/retroplug-cli render resources/roms/mGB.gb --out /tmp/render-smoke.wav --duration 500ms && node -e "const b=require('fs').readFileSync('/tmp/render-smoke.wav');if(b.length<45||b.toString('ascii',0,4)!=='RIFF'||b.toString('ascii',8,12)!=='WAVE')throw new Error('not a valid WAV');console.log('cli:render-smoke OK ('+b.length+' bytes)')"
scripts.cli:render-list-songs: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/cli-render build/bin/retroplug-cli render resources/roms/mGB.gb --sav packages/retroplug/test/lsdj/savs/all.sav --list-songs | node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8');if(!/0: HAPPY BD/.test(s)||!/1: YOURULE/.test(s))throw new Error('missing expected song names in:\n'+s);console.log('cli:render-list-songs OK')"
scripts.reaper:analyze-lsdj-sync: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-cli retroplug-example-session && RETROPLUG_USER_CONFIG_DIR=/tmp/cli-analyze build/bin/retroplug-cli build/cli/analyze-lsdj-sync.js ../resources/roms/lsdj/lsdj9_4_2.gb /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern && tools/reaper-stage.sh /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern_sys0.wav /tmp/lsdj-sync-pattern_sys1.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-metro-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-metro && RP_SCENARIO=midi-metro tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_metro.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-author.lua build/lsdj_midi-metro.rplg.zip
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-metro: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-metro && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_metro.rpp build/lsdj_midi-metro.rplg.zip && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-midi-metro.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-arduinoboy-metro-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js arduinoboy-metro && RP_SCENARIO=arduinoboy-metro tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-author.lua build/lsdj_arduinoboy-metro.rplg.zip
scripts.reaper:lsdj-arduinoboy-metro: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js arduinoboy-metro && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_arduinoboy_metro.rpp build/lsdj_arduinoboy-metro.rplg.zip && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-arduinoboy-metro.wav
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-drift-author: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-drift && RP_SCENARIO=midi-drift tools/run-reaper-author.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_drift.rpp build tools/reaper-lsdj-author.lua build/lsdj_midi-drift.rplg.zip
scripts.reaper:lsdj-midi-drift: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-lsdj-rplg.js midi-drift && tools/run-reaper-render.sh examples/reaper/lsdj_midi_drift.rpp build/lsdj_midi-drift.rplg.zip && tools/reaper-timing-analyze.py build/reaper-lsdj-midi-drift.wav --drift
scripts.reaper:editor-autoload: node scripts/cmake-build.js retroplug-vst3 && node tools/author-rplg.js && tools/run-reaper-editor-autoload.sh
